articles.title: How to solve the blood transfusion puzzle in Silent Hill Townfall
articles.excerpt: Here's how to obtain the missing blood bags and open the blood transfusion door in Silent Hill: Townfall
articles.body: The blood transfusion puzzle in Silent Hill: Townfall is more difficult than scary, and that's saying something, as this challenge takes place in a dark and monster-ridden hospital. To solve the blood transfusion puzzle, you must find the missing blood bags, place the blood bags in the correct slots, and find a connection between blood types.
articles.author: Marloes Valentina Stella

articles.title: How to save the patient in Silent Hill Townfall
articles.excerpt: Here's how to give the blood pressure, make an X-ray, and find the medicine in Silent Hill: Townfall's patient puzzle
articles.body: To help the patient in Silent Hill: Townfall , Zoe must overcome a series of challenges. Dr. Glenn, who's barking orders over the intercom, isn't especially helpful, so you must figure out how to read the patient's blood pressure, how to make an X-ray, and how to find the correct medicine infusion rates by yourself. The patient puzzle, aka the "Zoe: The Patient" mission, is one of the longest and hardest challenges in St. Amelia.
articles.author: Marloes Valentina Stella

articles.title: How to unlock the Community Gardens gate in Silent Hill Townfall
articles.excerpt: Here's how to obtain the Community Garden key in Silent Hill: Townfall and reach Mr. Stewart's house
articles.body: Unless you open the Community Gardens gate in Silent Hill: Townfall , Zoe won't be able to find her way to Mr. Stewart's house. Ignoring Mr. Stewart is no option; as a district nurse, Zoe must complete her home visits, and as a player, you must complete the "Zoe: Rounds" mission. On top of finding the Community Garden key, you must solve a door code puzzle to pass through the St. Amelia Community Gardens.
articles.author: Marloes Valentina Stella

articles.title: How to solve the scales puzzle in Silent Hill Townfall
articles.excerpt: Here's how to solve the pharmacy locker puzzle, enter Jess' house, and complete the scales puzzle in Silent Hill: Townfall
articles.body: The scales puzzle in Silent Hill: Townfall involves many steps, and they're far from obvious. First, you must interpret a very cryptic CRTV video, then you must open a pharmacy locker, and then you'll have to find Jess' house, which initially seems unreachable. Even if you've done all of that already, arranging the items on the scales is a challenge on its own.
articles.author: Marloes Valentina Stella

articles.title: Where to find the reception door code in Silent Hill Townfall
articles.excerpt: Here's where to find the clinic's reception door code in Silent Hill: Townfall and unlock an extra safe point
articles.body: The reception door code in Silent Hill: Townfall leads to a telephone, which, in turn, leads to an opportunity to save your game. Conveniently located in the Shorefront Family Clinic, at the start of the "Searching for Zoe" mission, you can already spot the telephone on the reception desk… Too bad the door is locked.
articles.author: Marloes Valentina Stella

articles.title: How to open the human organ box in Silent Hill Townfall
articles.excerpt: Here's how to restore power in Zoe's house in Silent Hill: Townfall and use it to open the human organ transplant box
articles.body: To open the human organ box in Silent Hill: Townfall , you need expert detective skills and a lot of nerve. Once you've obtained a flashlight and the first hint, you must restore electricity and sneak into a newspaper store — without alerting its unfriendly visitor. Only then will you be able to find the six-digit code that unlocks the human organ box.
articles.author: Marloes Valentina Stella

articles.body: A photo of the Dynamic Aviation A200 aircraft, which will conduct low-flying research flights over farmland near Greeley, Colorado, to measure emissions in October 2026. Dynamic Aviation Agricultural emissions represent an important and understudied part of Earth’s land and atmosphere systems. The FarmFlux mission will deploy more than a dozen sensors to measure ozone, methane, ammonia, particulates, and other pollutants rising from agricultural lands and animal farms and the interaction with the Earth’s atmosphere. The mission is jointly led by NASA’s Goddard Space Flight Center in Greenbelt, Maryland; Colorado State University; and Boston University.  The Colorado deployment is the first series of flights for the FarmFlux mission.

NASA, ESA, STScI, M. Pascale (UCLA); Image Processing: J. DePasquale (STScI) NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope captured this image of massive galaxy cluster MACS J0417 (left of center) on Sept. 19, 2026. This galaxy cluster acts as a gravitational lens , bending and magnifying light from objects far behind it. Supernova Athena, discovered by NASA’s James Webb Space Telescope in 2025, is predicted to reappear between now and early March 2027.
